source_version: Older public-domain Chinese Union Version (CUVS); not New Punctuation CUV or Revised CUV
punctuation: Modernized independently; lexical comparisons ignore punctuation and whitespace.

policy.canonical: Keep CUV wording and order within the Latin-selected passage extent. Replace 耶和华 with 主/神 according to Dominus/Deus.
policy.liturgical: Record essential authored adaptations and Latin additions; omit material absent from the Latin liturgical selection.
policy.deuterocanonical: Original translations from Latin following CUV conventions.
policy.instrumental_per: Use 借 for instrumental per/through, including prayer conclusions; this spelling convention also applies to quoted CUV wording. Retain 慰藉.
policy.chinese_asterisks: Omit asterisks from both Chinese columns; retain other notation.
policy.doxology: Glory Be: 愿荣耀归于父、子、圣灵。起初如何，今日依然，直到永远，世世无尽。阿们。 Long prayer conclusions: 借我们的主耶稣基督，你的儿子——他与你在圣灵的合一中，共生共治，独一的神，世世无尽。阿们。 Preserve grammatical-person and same-Spirit variants.
policy.intercession_marian_terminology: Intercession: 代求. Sancta Dei Genetrix: 神之圣母; preserve Latin superlatives.
policy.semper_virgin_title: Beata Maria semper Virgo and its grammatical variants use 永贞荣福马利亚.

limitations: Commentary review covers detected explicit quotations; unmarked scriptural allusions in commentary were not exhaustively reviewed.
One indirect commentary allusion, 人的命运在神手中, has no uniquely identifiable biblical source and was retained.
Original deuterocanonical translations and essential liturgical adaptations require editorial judgment; retained Latin and adaptation notes document those decisions.
